description: Environment of the stroppy runner process: logging, OTLP export, pool and driver options.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: LOG_LEVEL. debug traces how every parameter was resolved; it also turns on k6 --verbose.
fields.title: Log level

fields.name: log_format
fields.description: K6_LOG_FORMAT of the embedded k6 process. json is what the agent ships to the log store.
fields.title: Log format

fields.name: otlp_protocol
fields.description: K6_OTEL_EXPORTER_PROTOCOL.
fields.title: OTLP protocol

fields.name: otlp_endpoint
fields.description: K6_OTEL_GRPC_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT / K6_OTEL_HTTP_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT. Filled by the server: the agent's OTLP receiver on this machine.
fields.title: OTLP endpoint

fields.name: otlp_http_url_path
fields.description: K6_OTEL_HTTP_EXPORTER_URL_PATH; only read for the http/protobuf protocol.
fields.title: OTLP HTTP path

fields.name: otlp_insecure
fields.description: K6_OTEL_GRPC_EXPORTER_INSECURE / K6_OTEL_HTTP_EXPORTER_INSECURE. The endpoint is a local agent, so plaintext is the norm.
fields.title: OTLP insecure

fields.name: otlp_service_name
fields.description: K6_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.
fields.title: OTLP service name

fields.name: otlp_metric_prefix
fields.description: K6_OTEL_METRIC_PREFIX prepended to every k6 metric name.
fields.title: OTLP metric prefix

fields.name: otlp_headers
fields.description: K6_OTEL_HEADERS, comma-joined k=v. The server fills the run/tenant identity here (there is no separate label env var upstream).
fields.title: OTLP headers

fields.name: metrics_flush_interval
fields.description: K6_OTEL_EXPORT_INTERVAL: how often k6 pushes metric batches to the collector.
fields.title: Metrics flush interval

fields.name: threads
fields.description: GOMAXPROCS of the stroppy/k6 process; 0 leaves the Go default (one per CPU) and emits no variable.
fields.title: GOMAXPROCS

fields.name: pool_max_conns
fields.description: driver pool.maxConns. Keep it at or above the k6 VU count or VUs queue on the pool instead of the database.
fields.title: Pool max connections

fields.name: pool_min_conns
fields.description: driver pool.minConns: connections kept warm; equal to max removes connect latency from the measurement.
fields.title: Pool min connections

fields.name: pool_conn_lifetime
fields.description: driver pool.maxConnLifetime.
fields.title: Connection lifetime

fields.name: pool_conn_idle_time
fields.description: driver pool.maxConnIdleTime.
fields.title: Connection idle time

fields.name: insert_progress_interval
fields.description: driver insertProgress.interval: how often the load phase reports row progress (upstream default 10s).
fields.title: Insert progress interval

fields.name: insert_progress_stall_after
fields.description: driver insertProgress.stallAfter: warn when no rows moved for this long (upstream default 60s).
fields.title: Stall warning after

fields.name: insert_progress_mode
fields.description: driver insertProgress.mode.
fields.title: Insert progress mode

fields.name: error_mode
fields.description: driver errorMode: what a failing statement does to the run.
fields.title: Error mode

fields.name: bulk_size
fields.description: driver bulkSize: rows per bulk INSERT during load_data (upstream default 2500).
fields.title: Bulk size

fields.name: default_insert_method
fields.description: driver defaultInsertMethod; the fastest method differs per driver (native for pg/ydb, plain_bulk for mysql/picodata).
fields.title: Insert method

fields.name: driver_url
fields.description: driver url. Filled by the server from topology (the proxy or primary endpoint of the deployed database).
fields.title: Driver URL

fields.name: driver
fields.description: Which stroppy driver the workload talks through; the protocol decides which TLS/auth options exist.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: go-sql-driver/mysql tls parameter of the DSN.
fields.title: tls

fields.name: ssl_mode
fields.description: Picodata speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol on its pg port, so sslmode applies verbatim.
fields.title: sslmode

fields.name: ssl_mode
fields.description: sslmode of the libpq URL; the driver URL carries it as a query parameter.
fields.title: sslmode

fields.name: grpcs
fields.description: TLS is switched on by the URL scheme (grpcs://); this only records the intent for the URL the server builds.
fields.title: Use grpcs

fields.name: ca_cert_file
fields.description: driver caCertFile: PEM path, needed only for a private CA.
fields.title: CA certificate

fields.name: auth_user
fields.description: driver authUser for static credentials.
fields.title: Auth user

fields.name: auth_password
fields.description: driver authPassword for static credentials.
fields.title: Auth password

fields.name: auth_token
fields.description: driver authToken (IAM token) for managed YDB.
fields.title: Auth token

fields.name: tls_insecure_skip_verify
fields.description: driver tlsInsecureSkipVerify — testing only.
fields.title: Skip TLS verify
Driver

fields.name: driver_json
fields.description: Derived: the driver JSON stroppy reads from STROPPY_DRIVER_0.

computed.expr:
'{"driverType":"' + root.driver.driverType + '"' +
				 (("driver_url" in root) ? ',"url":"' + root.driver_url + '"' : "") +
				 ',"defaultInsertMethod":"' + root.default_insert_method + '"' +
				 ',"errorMode":"' + root.error_mode + '"' +
				 ',"bulkSize":' + string(root.bulk_size) +
				 ',"insertProgress":{"enabled":' + (root.insert_progress_mode != "off" ? "true" : "false") +
				 ',"interval":"' + string(root.insert_progress_interval) +
				 '","stallAfter":"' + string(root.insert_progress_stall_after) +
				 '","mode":"' + root.insert_progress_mode + '"}' +
				 ',"pool":{"maxConns":' + string(root.pool_max_conns) +
				 ',"minConns":' + string(root.pool_min_conns) +
				 ',"maxConnLifetime":"' + string(root.pool_conn_lifetime) +
				 '","maxConnIdleTime":"' + string(root.pool_conn_idle_time) + '"}' +
				 (("ca_cert_file" in root.driver) && root.driver.ca_cert_file != ""
					? ',"caCertFile":"' + root.driver.ca_cert_file + '"' : "") +
				 (("auth_user" in root.driver) && root.driver.auth_user != ""
					? ',"authUser":"' + root.driver.auth_user + '"' : "") +
				 (("auth_password" in root.driver) && root.driver.auth_password != ""
					? ',"authPassword":"' + root.driver.auth_password + '"' : "") +
				 (("auth_token" in root.driver) && root.driver.auth_token != ""
					? ',"authToken":"' + root.driver.auth_token + '"' : "") +
				 (("tls_insecure_skip_verify" in root.driver) && root.driver.tls_insecure_skip_verify
					? ',"tlsInsecureSkipVerify":true' : "") +
				 "}"

fields.title: Rendered STROPPY_DRIVER_0

computed.expr:
!("otlp_headers" in root) || size(root.otlp_headers) == 0 ? "" :
				 "K6_OTEL_HEADERS=" + root.otlp_headers.map(k, k + "=" + string(root.otlp_headers[k])).join(",")

rules.message: the stall warning must be no earlier than one progress report
